scope: Single bounded CPU continuation authorized by user; exact finite model only
reuse: All three saved step-zero states and all old equal-weight/CE curves in one_step_to_terminal_cpu_20261110; original model, qref and reverse kernel unchanged
gradient_scaling: Raw gradients of the existing normalized costs, no per-objective gradient normalization or tuned coefficient
direction: Minimum Euclidean norm convex combination of five exact gradients; plain theta -= 0.2 * combination
solver: Enumerate all 31 nonempty simplex faces, affine least squares with rcond=1e-12, reject infeasible barycentric coefficients, verify simplex and full KKT inequality residual <=1e-8 after common Gram scaling. No ridge. Roundoff-only negative coefficients >=-1e-10 may be clipped and rechecked.
zero_direction: Norm <=1e-12 is recorded as numerical stationarity; no fallback or artificial rescaling
gate: Synthetic solver cases including duplicates/opposing gradients; all five objective finite differences <=1e-7 at each starting state; source/state identity checks
record: Every update coefficients, gradient norms, directional and actual five-objective changes, displacement and KKT residual; every state full terminal distribution and per-objective risks; no best-step selection
success_interpretation: Joint local improvement alone insufficient; assess terminal structure costs, diversity and progress versus reused equal-weight comparator. Magnitudes may be smaller; equal learning rate is not equal displacement or compute. Splitting two triangle types and using multiobjective direction jointly change the optimization rule; not isolated effects.
